caption: The drawing features a single object positioned centrally against a plain, light beige background. The object is round and has a metallic, yellowish-gold color with hints of green and shading for depth. Its base is a wide, flat, circular disk with a slightly raised middle section. Atop the base, there is a smaller cylindrical section that transitions into an even smaller, vertical cylinder resembling a chimney or smokestack. On the uppermost cylinder, there are four evenly spaced black dots arranged in a horizontal line near the top edge. To one side of the central cylinder, there is a crank handle with a circular knob. The object is rendered with careful gradients and blended color, creating subtle highlights and shadows. Toward the lower right of the object is a small red star, accompanied by the text "M.A.R.S" written in red capital letters.
title: Lamp
